title: Oozy Buttery Mexican Rainbow Trout Chiles Rellenos
description: A buttery, crumbly, Mexican dish featuring rainbow trout, wrapped in a ssam-style chiles rellenos, perfect for a midnight craving. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe combines the flavors of Mexico with the delicate taste of rainbow trout.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butterfly the rainbow trout fillets by cutting them in half lengthwise and opening them up like a book.
Stuff each trout fillet with a quarter cup of queso fresco, a tablespoon of chopped onion, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Wrap each stuffed trout fillet in a roasted poblano pepper, securing it with a toothpick if necessary.
Place the wrapped trout fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about an inch of space between each fillet.
Drizzle the softened butter over the top of each fillet, making sure they are fully coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake the trout fillets in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the fillets from the oven and squeeze a tablespoon of lime juice over the top of each one.
Serve the oozy, buttery Mexican rainbow trout chiles rellenos hot, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
